why.never: Pushing is how your work reaches your teammates. Until you push, only your computer has it.

hints.never: Open the terminal, `cd 06-push`, and think about where you want to send the branch.

hints: The command is `git push origin issue-18-team-colors`.
Copy it exactly, including the branch name, then Verify.

why.never: Pulling is how you get your teammates' work into your copy.
why.bit: Pull downloads and merges new commits from `origin`.

hints.never: You must be on `develop`. `cd 07-pull`, then ask git to get the new commits.

hints: If it says you have no tracking information, try `git pull origin develop`.

why.never: A stash lets you switch branches without committing half-done work.

hints.never: The order is: shelve your work, fix the typo on develop, come back, take your work off the shelf.
hints.bit: Stash, fix on develop, return, pop.

hints: Commands in order: `git stash`, `git checkout develop`, edit and `git commit -am "Fix typo"`, `git checkout issue-21-new-motor`, `git stash pop`.
Don't commit your unfinished work on issue-21-new-motor. If you did, undo it with `git reset HEAD~1` and start again.
